name: Ded Gramarye IV

perks.name: Rifled Barrel
perks.desc:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

perks.name: Smoothbore
perks.desc: Smooth shotgun barrel. Greatly increases range at the cost of more projectile spread.

perks.name: Smallbore
perks.desc:
Dual strength barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases stability

perks.name: Barrel Shroud
perks.desc:
Balanced shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

perks.name: Corkscrew Rifling
perks.desc:
Balanced barrel. 
  •  Slightly increases range and stability
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

perks.name: Full Choke
perks.desc: Tightened barrel. Reduces projectile spread when aiming down sights at the cost of precision damage.

perks.name: Assault Mag
perks.desc:
This shotgun's magazine is optimized for quick combat.
  •  Greatly increases stability
  •  Increases rate of fire

perks.name: Appended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon's magazine is built for higher capacity.
  •  Increases magazine size

perks.name: Tactical Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has multiple tactical improvements.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases magazine size

perks.name: Extended Mag
perks.desc:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Steady Rounds
perks.desc:
This magazine is optimized for recoil control.
  •  Greatly increases stability 
  •  Slightly decreases range
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

perks.name: Accurized Rounds
perks.desc:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

perks.name: Light Mag
perks.desc:
Improved reload and range.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases range

perks.name: Flared Magwell
perks.desc:
Optimized for fast reloading.
  •  Slightly increases stability
  •  Greatly increases reload speed

perks.name: Threat Detector
perks.desc: Increased reload, stability, and handling when enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Slickdraw
perks.desc: Significantly increases handling, significantly decreases target acquisition.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Eddy Current
perks.desc: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified. This effect is improved when you are amplified.

perks.name: Surplus
perks.desc: Increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

perks.name: Discord
perks.desc: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Voltshot
perks.desc: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

perks.name: Surrounded
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus damage when three or more enemies are in close proximity.

perks.name: Disruption Break
perks.desc: Breaking an enemy's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for a brief period.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.desc: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn Enhanced
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage for an improved duration. While this buff is active, grenade or melee final blows of the same damage type greatly increase its damage for an improved duration.

perks.name: Wild Card
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon have a chance to create experimental submunitions at the target's location.

notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 108 from 9 July 2024 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/20WqdTYGB2K4SfWYePZWo1?si=0c706567ddea4e10) with @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE / PvE-MinorSpec / PvE-MajorSpec / PvE-EndGame / PvE-God / M+KB / Controller): First-choice PvE pick for add-clearing in general content. "Ded Gramarye" translates as "dead" and "occult learning, magic, or enchantment" from archaic English so, necromancy, at a guess. First, the Wild Card origin trait works well on a shotgun, as the little energy bolts inherit its high combatant weapon scaling. The weapon itself has quite poor stats but it boasts some great, and unique, possible trait perk pairings. You can go with any barrel perk of your preference, other than Smoothbore or Rifled Barrel. Assault Mag and then Tactical Mag are the best of the magazine perks. As a slightly off-piste choice, the trait perk pairing of Discord and Chain Reaction - which is excellent on shotguns as the explosion damage also inherits the damage scaling - or Surrounded for +47% damage when enhanced, will allow you to get a kill with your other weapon, and then go on a tear for 7s refunding every killing shot fired. For a double special loadout, this is really useful for ammo economy. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

"Ded Gramarye" translates as "dead" and "occult learning, magic, or enchantment" from archaic English so, necromancy, at a guess. First, the Wild Card origin trait works well on a shotgun, as the little energy bolts inherit its high combatant weapon scaling. If you're running Tractor Cannon and double shotgun, this could find a way into your loadout with the trait pairing of Slickdraw for fast ready and stow and Vorpal Weapon for its easy +15% damage against Majors and Bosses. Recommended MW: Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag mod.

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "A sleeper of a weapon this shotgun gets both Chain Reaction and Discord allowing for maximum carnage with a single weapon kill. Any weapon kill then swapping to Ded Gramarye IV will give you 8 seconds of infinite shots that explode enemies. What more could you ask for? Voltshot is another great perk as shotguns naturally load one bullet at a time so you can shoot once, reload that once and your next shot will apply all that Jolting goodness. This can be done indefinitely as long as you have ammo. I think on Arc and even neutral builds this might become one of the top picks, the issue is getting one to drop." Recommended MW: Reload Speed.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "Over in PvP this shotgun finds itself in a very similar situation to Xenoclast IV. Good perks, Disruption Break for easier swap clean ups but falls victim to its own archetype. If this were an aggressive frame shotgun it would immediately be on my radar and others as a top competitive option, but lightweights just lack the stopping power and the pellet spread to be as competitive." Recommended MW: Range or Handling.
